title: French Alps · The great peaks of the Alps
description: Track your ascents of the main summits in the French Alps. Free app for iOS and Android.
heroTagline: The great Alps, from Mont Blanc to the Vanoise.
whatIsTitle: What is the French Alps challenge?
whatIsParagraphs: The French Alps hold some of Europe's most iconic summits: Mont Blanc, Barre des Écrins, Grande Casse, Mont Pelvoux, La Meije. Serious alpinism, but also attainable objectives for anyone who trains for them.
This challenge covers the emblematic peaks in a manageable list. It isn't exhaustive — it aims to honour the giants of each massif: Mont Blanc, Vanoise, Écrins, Oisans.
With the app you carry the list on your phone and log each summit with a photo and date.

faqs.a: Mont Blanc, at 4,808 metres — the roof of Western Europe.
Most of them, yes. Several peaks require rope, crampons and ice axe. A few are walkable in summer.

faqs.q: When's the best time to go?
faqs.a: June to September for most; Mont Blanc has a narrower window.
